## Specification

As for RHINELAB tradition, we are to present the laboratory specific *classification identification*. This time it is rather easy because what you have here are, well, different stuffs altogether at once of the main website template, serial `3` at all (there are two more, obviously, so go look them all will you). 

### Issuer

RHINELAB@CAD Central Administration, and maintained by Lab Leader (Bui Gia Khanh). 

### Version

#### v0.1. 

Not a lot of features added, but have it enough for the time being. Added most of the functionality and organization. Still missing tables. 

v0.2. 

Added information. Now the format of the website is handled in `rhinelab-html` format. The current configuration is as this: 

```yml
format:
  rhinelab-html:
    number-sections: true
    number-depth: 3
    code-link: true
    code-tools:
      toggle: true
    code-fold: false
    code-overflow: wrap
    reference-location: margin
```
Will add table utilities next time.
